description:
• Cloudflare fetching is now automatic — removed the manual "Use API for Chapters" toggle. The app always tries the API first and only falls back to in-app browser (WebView) fetching per domain when the API path keeps failing.
• Added a "Forced WebView Domains" screen under Settings → General, listing domains that fell back to WebView fetching. Each self-heals (reverts to the API path) automatically after 15 days, or you can toggle it off manually.
• When a Cloudflare challenge can't be solved automatically, you're now routed to manual verification; after you solve it, the fetch resumes automatically.
• Live loading status now shows what's happening (checking cache, verifying with Cloudflare, falling back to in-app browser, etc.) on search, novel details, chapter list, and chapter reading.
• NovelUpdates chapter loading now gates on login cookies and prompts you to log in when they're missing.
• Reader overlay: moved the floating menu button to screen center; moved the JavaScript toggle onto the bottom bar (styled like Reader Mode) and the Font control into the settings menu.
